summary: Marpai, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to two promissory notes issued to its CEO. The notes, originally maturing April 11 and May 10, 2026, for $410,000 and $250,000 respectively, each bearing 12% annual interest, had their maturity extended to September 1, 2026. All other terms remain unchanged. This is a routine debt modification, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is involved. The filing simply extends the repayment timeline.
